\caption[GRPO: models, rewards, seeds]{GRPO strand (\file{sim/llm/LLM\_PROTOCOL.md}): two small open models, Qwen2.5 with 0.5 billion parameters and Llama 3.2 with 1 billion, trained for 100 steps on the \texttt{mul2} task (product of two numbers from 12 to 99), with the true reward and then with a reward decided by a coin toss, five seeds (0 to 2 then 3 and 4, deviation 14). First-attempt success: sampled pass@1 on the test problems, in percent; gain: step 100 minus step 0, in points; cut-off answers: share of answers that hit the 160-token limit before giving a result, all scored as wrong. Device: Apple GPU (MPS) or CPU; three Qwen runs moved to CPU after non-finite gradients on MPS (deviations 10 and 11), so device and seed are confounded for Qwen. Bottom part: the preregistered statistic, mean of the per-seed gains with a 95\% percentile bootstrap interval (10,000 draws, \texttt{random.Random(0)}), very rough with five seeds; \textbf{in bold}, intervals that exclude zero. The Llama configuration with the random reward is summarised over its four finished runs (deviation 16), with the sensitivity to the missing gain. Sources: \file{sim/llm/results/summary\_5.json}, \file{gains\_5.json}, \file{extra\_5.json}; cut-off share at step 0: first evaluation of each file \file{sim/llm/results/<model>/mul2/<reward>/seed<s>.jsonl}.}
